verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              ततो भयं विष्णुमयं श्रुत्वा दैतेयदानवाः। उद्योगं विपुलं चक्रुर्युद्धाय युधि दुर्जयाः॥१॥
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रवृतधर्मो यज्ञादिः संवृत्तः सम्यक् प्रवृत्तः विष्णोर्गिरं श्रुत्वा संवृत्तः॥३९॥

verses.sanskrit: मयस्तु काञ्चनमयं त्रिनल्वान्तरमव्ययम्। चतुश्चक्रं विक्रमन्तं सुकल्पितमहायुधम्॥२॥
verses.english: Demon मय getting into a four-wheeled chariot entirely made with gold; as broad as twelve hundred cubits; voyages through divers and difficult routes in space, water, or earth; well-equipped with outrageous weaponry...
verses.bhavadeepa: चत्वारिंशे त्रियुक्तेऽथ देवासुरसमागमे। दैत्यसंहननं पूर्वं वर्ण्यते वीरवल्लभम्॥१॥ ततः विष्णुमयं विष्णुप्रधानं भयं दैत्यानां श्रुत्वा॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: किङ्किणीजालनिर्घोषं द्वीपिचर्मपरिष्कृतम्। खचितं रत्नजालैश्च हेमजालैश्च भूषितम्॥३॥
verses.english: Furnished with jangling swags of tinkling-bells; upholstered with tiger skins; adorned with latticed jewel and gold drapes...
verses.bhavadeepa: त्रिनल्वान्तरं द्वादशशतहस्ता विस्तृतम् “नल्वः किष्कुचतुः  शतम्” इत्युक्तेः। मयः काञ्चनमयं रथम् आरोहदिति सप्तमेनान्वयः। महान्ति आयुधानि यस्मिन् विक्रमन्तं विषमेऽपि जलाग्न्यादिस्थाने गच्छन्तम्॥२॥

verses.sanskrit: स्वक्षं रथवरोदग्रं सूपस्थानमगोपमम्। ईहामृगगणाकीर्णं पक्षिभिश्च विराजितम्। दिव्यास्त्रतूणीरधरं पयोधरनिनादितम्॥४॥
verses.english: Stands high among all the best chariots; rider’s cabin - सूप-स्थानम् - merits comparison with a mountain; assorted with numerous– ईहामृग गण = कृत्रिम सत्त्व समूह - artificial beings, say androids, pongoids etc robots inclusive of avinoids; stockpiles many celestial missiles and quivers; peals like thundering cloud...

verses.sanskrit: गदापरिघसम्पूर्णं मूर्तिमन्तमिवार्णवम्। हेमकेयूरवलयं स्वर्णमण्डलकूबरम्॥५॥
verses.english: Stretching his huge bow of many thousand cubits in dimension, the demon named वराह also stood in the van of army with saggy matted hair – स अवरोह - like a fig tree covered with slouching branches...
verses.bhavadeepa: ये रथेषु वरास्तेषु उदग्रं श्रेष्ठं सूपस्थानं शोभननीडम् अगोपमं पर्वततुल्यम्। ईहामृगगणैः कृत्रिमसत्त्वसमूहैराकीर्णं व्याप्तम्॥४॥

verses.sanskrit: सपताकध्वजोदग्रं सादित्यमिव मन्दरम्। गजेन्द्राम्भोदसदृशं लम्बकेसरवर्चसम्॥६॥
verses.english: Stands high among all the best chariots; rider’s cabin - सूप-स्थानम् - merits comparison with a mountain; assorted with numerous– ईहामृग गण = कृत्रिम सत्त्व समूह - artificial beings, say androids, pongoids etc robots inclusive of avinoids; stockpiles many celestial missiles and quivers; peals like thundering cloud...

verses.sanskrit: युक्तमृक्षसहस्रेण सहस्राम्बुदनादितम्। दीप्तमाकाशगं दिव्यं रथं पररथारुजम्॥७॥
verses.english: Encharioted on such an effulgent and breathtaking chariot that can trounce enemy chariots, demon मय, थे warmonger, shone forth like the sun on his ascension to the top of loftiest Mt. मेरु॥।

verses.sanskrit: अध्यतिष्ठद्रणाकाङ्क्षी मेरुं दीप्तमिवांशुमान्। तारस्तु क्रोशविस्तारमायसं वायसध्वजम्॥८॥
verses.english: Its beadings and the chassis-to yoke-beam are golden; when its flags and flag staffs are skyrocketing to touch the sun, it glittered like the sun itself against the backdrop of Mt. मन्दर; comparable to a huge elephant and a vast ocean, it looks bearish and in plunge, it is lionish; it is fraught with a thousand bears, say ursine creatures, say ursoidal robos; its clangouring is like the clang from a mass of thousand clouds...

verses.sanskrit: शैलोत्करसमाकीर्णं नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम्। काललोहाष्टचरणं लोहेषायुगकूबरम्। तिमिराङ्गारकिरणं गर्जन्तमिव तोयदम्॥९॥
verses.english: Encharioted on such an effulgent and breathtaking chariot that can trounce enemy chariots, demon मय, थे warmonger, shone forth like the sun on his ascension to the top of loftiest Mt. मेरु॥।

verses.sanskrit: लोहजालेन महता सगवाक्षेण दंशितम्। आयसैः परिघैः कीर्णं क्षेपणीयैस्तथाश्मभिः॥१०॥
verses.english: Demon तार on his part enmcharioted on a chariot that is widthwise some two miles, hoisting a flag with crow symbol; its structure resemblant of a huge collection of mountains, or a heap of mascara; its eight wheels, chassis-yoke coupler etc are all made of cast-iron; aglow with sable and cindery flashes; thundering like black clouds...
verses.bhavadeepa: शैलोत्करः पर्वतानां राशिः काललोहाष्टचरणं कृष्णायसमया अष्टौ चरणाश्चक्राणि यस्य तम्। तिमिराङ्गाराः कृष्णा इङ्गलाः तद्वत् किरणा यस्य॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: प्रासैः पाशैश्च विततैरवसक्तैश्च मुद्गरैः। शोभितं त्रासनीयैश्च तोमरैः सपरश्वधैः॥११॥
verses.english: Demon अरिष्ट, the son of बलि, stood there wielding huge boulder-shots, and though looked tired he is something like an iron mountain...

verses.sanskrit: उद्यन्तं द्विषतां हेतोर्द्वितीयमिव मन्दरम्। युक्तं खरसहस्रेण सोऽध्यारोहद्रथोत्तमम्॥१२॥
verses.english: And demon तार encharioted such a best chariot that is surging by reason of its enemies, looking next only to Mt, मन्दर, and yoked with a thousand donkeys...

verses.sanskrit: विरोचनस्तु सङ्क्रुद्धो गदापाणिरवस्थितः। प्रमुखे तस्य सैन्यस्य दीप्तशृङ्ग इवाचलः॥१३॥
verses.english: The highly enraged demon विरोचन taking up a club stood in the van of army like a mountain with outstanding summits...

verses.sanskrit: युक्तं हयसहस्रेण हयग्रीवस्तु दानवः। स्यन्दनं वाहयामास सपत्नानीकमर्दनः॥१४॥
verses.english: Demon हय-ग्रीव, who is the repressor of the armies of his co-brothers - सपत्न-आनीकम् - namely gods, embarked on a chariot drawn by a thousand steeds...

verses.sanskrit: व्यायतं बहुसाहस्रं धनुर्विस्फारयन्महत्। वराहः प्रमुखे तस्थौ सावरोह इवाचलः॥१५॥
verses.english: Stretching his huge bow of many thousand cubits in dimension, the demon named वराह also stood in the van of army with saggy matted hair – स अवरोह - like a fig tree covered with slouching branches...

verses.sanskrit: खरस्तु विक्षरन्दर्पान्नेत्राभ्यां रोषजं जलम्। स्फुरद्दन्तौष्ठवदनः सङ्ग्रामं सोऽभ्यकाङ्क्षत॥१६॥
verses.english: Shedding tears of anger out of haughtiness the demon खर stood hankering for the battle while his lips quivered, teeth gnashed and face trembled...
verses.bhavadeepa: सावरोहः जटावान् अचलो वृक्षः न्यग्रोध इत्यर्थः॥१५॥

verses.sanskrit: त्वष्टा त्वष्टादशहयं यानमास्थाय दानवः। व्यूहितो दानवैर्व्यूहैः परिचक्राम वीर्यवान्॥१७॥
verses.english: The demon श्वेत, the son of विप्रचित्ति, wearing white ear-hangings, stood in the van of war reminding a white mountain...

verses.sanskrit: विप्रचित्तिसुतः श्वेतः श्वेतकुण्डलभूषणः। श्वेतशैलप्रतीकाशो युद्धायाभिमुखः स्थितः॥१८॥
अरिष्टो बलिपुत्रस्तु वरिष्ठोऽद्रिशिलायुधैः। युद्धायातिष्ठदायस्तो धराधर इवापरः॥१९॥
verses.english: Demon अरिष्ट, the son of बलि, stood there wielding huge boulder-shots, and though looked tired he is something like an iron mountain...

verses.sanskrit: किशोरस्त्वतिसंहर्षात्किशोर इव चोदितः। अभवद्दैत्यसैन्यस्य मध्ये रविरिवोदितः॥२०॥
verses.english: A young दानव by name किशोर, resembling a young charger in pride, appeared like the sun arisen in the midst of दैत्य army...

verses.sanskrit: लम्बस्तु लम्बमेघाभः प्रलम्बाम्बरभूषणः। दैत्यव्यूहगतो भाति सनीहार इवांशुमान्॥२१॥
verses.english: दानव लम्ब who looks like an overlong cloud, now wearing further overlong dress and ornaments and moving in the midst of the दैत्य formations has shone forth like the sun whose disc is just caught for eclipsing by the demon-planet राहु– कन्कण ग्रस्त अर्क वत् – at which time the sun will be a little more reddish...

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्भानुर्वक्रयोधी च दशनौष्ठेक्षणायुधः। हसंस्तिष्ठति दैत्यानां प्रमुखे स महाग्रहः॥२२॥
verses.english: दानव स्वर्भानु who undertakes gorilla-tactics wielding his own teeth, lips and eyes as weapons, stood laughing in the van of army like a massive alligator...

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये हयगता भान्ति नागस्कन्धगताः परे। सिंहव्याघ्रगताश्चान्ये वराहर्क्षगताः परे॥२३॥
verses.english: Some दानवा-s participating in that war shone forth riding on horses while others on the elephants; some came riding on the lions and tigers while others on boars and bears; some rode asses and camels; some came riding on clouds, some on various birds, while some more fought just walking on the wind...

verses.sanskrit: केचित्खरोष्ट्रयातारः केचित्तोयदवाहनाः। नानापक्षिगताश्चान्ये केचित्पवनवाहनाः॥२४॥
verses.english: Other दैत्या-s proceeded on foot. Some दैत्या-s are with dreadful faces, while some others are with one foot, and some more with two feet... some warmongers are war whooping, while others are waggling their arms, while some more are slapping their own biceps as wrestlers do... all the leading दानवा-s roared with the roar of proud tigers... and those demons with fierce clubs, maces and their mace-like arms and with their expertise in the use of bows frightened the gods...

verses.sanskrit: पत्तयश्चापरे दैत्या भीषणा विकृताननाः। एकपादा द्विपादाश्च नर्दन्तो युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः॥२५॥
verses.english: Thereupon, hearing of the Vishnu-laden-fear, the indomitable demons and ogres began to make preparations for a great scale war...

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्ष्वेडमाना बहवः स्फोटयन्तश्च ते भुजान्। दृप्तशार्दूलनिर्घोषा नेदुर्दानवपुङ्गवाः॥२६॥
verses.english: In this way that army of दानवा-s rigged up with all the apparatus of war, thick with thousands of demons whose surge itself is like the whirls of wind, flares of fire, torrents of water, blinding of clouds, bumps of boulders, and which army is now in efflux like mad streams of battle-water, has confronted the hosts of gods, as if theirs is an army of clouds ready for the weapon-burst on gods...

verses.sanskrit: ते गदापरिघैरुग्रैर्धनुर्व्यायामशालिनः। बाहुभिः परिघाकारैस्तर्जयन्ति स्म देवताः॥२७॥
प्रासैः पाशैश्च खड्गैश्च तोमराङ्कुशपट्टिशैः। चिक्रीडुस्ते शतघ्नीभिः शतधारैश्च मुद्गरैः॥२८॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the forty-third chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the army of दैत्या-s.

verses.sanskrit: गण्डशैलैश्च शैलैश्च परिघैश्चोत्तमायुधैः। चक्रैश्च दैत्यप्रवराश्चक्रुरानन्दितं बलम्॥२९॥
एवं तद्दानवं सैन्यं सर्वं युद्धबलोत्कटम्। देवताभिमुखं तस्थौ मेघानीकमिवोत्थितम्॥३०॥
तदद्भुतं दैत्यसहस्रगाढं वाय्वग्नितोयाम्बुदशैलकल्पम्। बलं रणौघाभ्युदयावकीर्णं युयुत्सयोन्मत्तमिवाबभासे॥३१॥
